AI secret-harvest needs two collection roles
============================================

`ai-coding-tool-secret-harvest` convicted the mutmutco Claude-plugin CLI,
whose push-wall names AI-tool config directories to REFUSE them and whose
bundle walks trees for scratch management: one of the two required `any`
legs was the baseline `.key` extension string (conf 0.5), which exclusion
lists, archive validators, and docs all contain. The leg was removed from
the hostile threshold; the lone `pem-file-extension-reference` string
followed the same path after an agent-supervision harness (readdir loops
over git worktrees plus an incidental `.pem` mention) was convicted the
same way. Each remaining leg (repeated reads, two kinds of credential
files) establishes a distinct collection role.

Run `python3 testdata/ai-harvest-guard/check.py <scratch-directory>` with
a scratch path containing no test-like tokens (the walk legs carry a
test-harness suppressor, so a test-named scratch would vacuous-pass both
fixtures; `check.py` refuses such paths). `negative-guard.js` must report
no hostile findings while keeping its walk/cluster/readdir legs;
`positive-stealer.js` must still report the harvest verdict.
